sql.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, TRUNCATE, CREATE, ALTER, DROP, COMMENT, VACUUM, ANALYZE or REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW statement. A person approves the exact text and sees Redshift's plan.

parameters.description: Values of the statement's :name parameters. The Data API passes each as text and Redshift casts it; write NULL in the SQL itself.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
